post.description:
Store one OpenLineage RunEvent, the default endpoint of OpenLineage's HTTP transport
(spec 04). Screened exactly as one item of an event file.

The one async endpoint (spec 06): it streams the body so an oversized one is refused
at the cap instead of buffered (ADR 0024), then ingests in the thread pool.

202.description: A JobEvent or DatasetEvent: not stored.

400.description: Rejected: the detail gives the kind and failing field, never content.

401.description: When a token is configured: no valid bearer token (ADR 0024).

413.description: The body is larger than one event may be (1 MiB).

415.description: The body has a Content-Encoding; send the event uncompressed.

500.description: An unexpected failure; the detail reveals nothing about it.

AllocatedAmount.title: AllocatedAmount
AllocatedAmount.description: Allocations of one Allocation Category and Confidence (none for Idle).

Allocation.title: Allocation
Allocation.description: The part of one Billing Line assigned to one Allocation Target.

AllocationCurrencyReconciliation.title: AllocationCurrencyReconciliation
AllocationCurrencyReconciliation.description: Every line of one currency and Cost Basis; never added to another currency's.

AllocationLineReconciliation.title: AllocationLineReconciliation
AllocationLineReconciliation.description:
One Billing Line, Cost Basis and currency: what was billed, what the Allocations hold,
and the Reconciliation Delta between them (zero when Reconciliation holds). A line the bill
lacks, or a currency other than the line's, is billed zero, so invented amounts show.

AllocationMethod.title: AllocationMethod
AllocationMethod.description: How an amount was allocated; for Unallocated amounts, why (spec 03, M4 structure 10).

AllocationPage.title: AllocationPage
AllocationPage.description:
One page of a single Allocation Snapshot's Allocations; offsets are stable because
the snapshot never changes.

AllocationReconciliation.title: AllocationReconciliation
AllocationReconciliation.description:
One Allocation Snapshot's Allocations against the Export Snapshot its Calculation Run
read: per-currency totals over every line, and one page of the lines.

CostBasis.title: CostBasis
CostBasis.description: The FOCUS cost column a figure is taken from; bases are never added together.

CostExplanation.title: CostExplanation
CostExplanation.description:
The chain behind one Allocation (GLOSSARY): its Billing Line, the Allocation, its
Evidence resolved, and the Roll-ups it contributes to.

CostSummaries.title: CostSummaries
CostSummaries.description: The Cost Summary of each matching Snapshot Scope's current Allocation Snapshot.

CostSummary.title: CostSummary
CostSummary.description: Where one Allocation Snapshot put its Snapshot Scope's bill, for one Cost Basis.

CurrencySummary.title: CurrencySummary
CurrencySummary.description: One currency's part of a Cost Summary; never added to another currency's.

DbtNode.title: DbtNode
DbtNode.description: A node of one invocation's dbt manifest: catalog entry and static dependencies.

ExplainedModelExecution.title: ExplainedModelExecution
ExplainedModelExecution.description:
The Model Execution an Allocation's Evidence links, as the workload store holds it;
`execution` or `dbt_node` is None when that part was never ingested.

ExplainedRollup.title: ExplainedRollup
ExplainedRollup.description: A Roll-up the Allocation contributes to, in the Allocation's currency and Cost Basis.

ExplainedWorkloadRun.title: ExplainedWorkloadRun
ExplainedWorkloadRun.description: A Workload Run an Allocation's Evidence names; `run` is None if never reported.

Health.title: Health
Health.description: Whether the database opens as a current data-finops database; a status, not an error.

LineageReceipt.title: LineageReceipt
LineageReceipt.description: What storing one RunEvent changed, as the workload store's ingest result counts it.

LineageUnsupported.title: LineageUnsupported
LineageUnsupported.description: A valid JobEvent or DatasetEvent: received, not stored (spec 04).

ModelExecution.title: ModelExecution
ModelExecution.description: One run of a dbt node within one invocation.

Provenance.title: Provenance
Provenance.description: How one Allocation Snapshot was made, enough to reproduce any figure in it.

QueryCorrelation.title: QueryCorrelation
QueryCorrelation.description: Identifiers extracted from a trusted query comment; the query text is not kept.

ReadExportSnapshot.title: ReadExportSnapshot
ReadExportSnapshot.description: The Export Snapshot a Calculation Run read.

RollupAmount.title: RollupAmount
RollupAmount.description: One Roll-up total, in one currency and Cost Basis.

RollupEntry.title: RollupEntry
RollupEntry.description:
What one Model Execution or Workload Run cost: a view over Allocations, never an
Allocation (GLOSSARY Roll-up).

RollupPage.title: RollupPage
RollupPage.description: One page of one Allocation Snapshot's Roll-ups at one level, ordered by key.

ServedSnapshot.title: ServedSnapshot
ServedSnapshot.description: The Allocation Snapshot a read served, and the Calculation Run that made it.

SnapshotScope.title: SnapshotScope
SnapshotScope.description: What an Export Snapshot covers; a restatement replaces the snapshot for its scope.

UnallocatedAmount.title: UnallocatedAmount
UnallocatedAmount.description: Unallocated amounts for one reason (the Allocation's method), Adjustments aside.

WorkloadRun.title: WorkloadRun
WorkloadRun.description: One OpenLineage run as reported, including dbt-ol's per-model runs (ADR 0022).

WorkloadRunFlag.title: WorkloadRunFlag
WorkloadRunFlag.description: Disagreements among a run's stored observations, shown rather than resolved.

WorkloadRunStatus.title: WorkloadRunStatus
WorkloadRunStatus.description: Derived from a run's terminal event, whatever the arrival order (spec 02).
